Maya Chen: Heads-up: locking press + analyst briefing logistics for the Benchmark launch. Embargo = 2026-06-10T15:00Z. I made a Checklist tab in Quick Facts. Please claim slots & quotes. Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=benchmark-quickfacts-2026

Lena Ortiz: I can run analyst invites and the one-pager. Need confirmed quote text and attributions by tomorrow noon PT.

Aaron Patel: Draft performance quote: "Redwood Inference reduces per-token inference cost by up to 3× on common LLM workloads (A100-80GB, fp16+quant) while meeting production latency SLOs." — Aaron Patel, Head of Product. Approve?

Jordan (Legal): Looks ok but include run IDs in Fact-check and avoid absolute claims without backing. Provide perf logs. I'll sign off after that.

Samir Gupta: Pushed perf logs + run IDs to Fact-check tab: run-20260602-1a, run-20260603-2b. Flagged two anomaly runs for review.

Maya Chen: Great — timeline: quotes + approvals by 12:00 PT tomorrow; legal sign-off before PR distributes. PR Bot will run internal dry-run 2026-06-08 09:00 PT. Direct any analyst follow-ups to ops@redwood with the run IDs.
